card.title: The Gāyatrī Mantra
card.sub: Seer Viśvāmitra · a meditation on the light of the Sun

characters.Viśvāmitra: The sage Vishvamitra: an elderly rishi with a long white beard and white hair tied in a topknot, bare-chested with a plain ochre cloth over one shoulder and an ochre dhoti, a rudraksha mala, a calm serene face. He is the only person in the picture.

scenes.title: Night: the sage comes down to the river
scenes.description: Night at a wide sacred river. The sage walks down the stone steps of a ghat toward the dark water, seen from behind, holding a small clay diya with an open flame in both hands in front of his chest. A deep indigo sky full of stars and the Milky Way above, reflected in the water. Full-bleed scene, no border.
scenes.motion: The sage walks steadily down the steps toward the water, the lamp flame swaying in his hands. No other people appear.
scenes.camera: The camera follows him from behind at a walking pace.

scenes.title: The lamp on the water
scenes.description: Close view at water level at night: two weathered hands gently set a small clay diya with an open flame onto the dark rippling river, stars reflected in the water. Full-bleed scene, no border.
scenes.motion: The hands release the lamp, it floats away from them on the current and ripples spread outward in rings.
scenes.camera: Low camera at water level, slowly tracking the lamp.

scenes.title: The lamp drifts out
scenes.description: Night: a single small clay diya with an open flame, floating drifting on a wide dark river under a vast sky full of stars and the Milky Way, its golden reflection on the water, mist on the far bank. No people.
scenes.motion: The lamp drifts steadily away across the water and the stars twinkle; its reflection trembles on the ripples. No people or hands appear.
scenes.camera: The camera rises slowly upward, revealing the vast sky.

scenes.title: Dawn wakes: birds rise
scenes.description: Pre-dawn over the wide river: deep blue sky with the last stars, a pale golden glow on the horizon, mist on the water, a flock of white egrets standing in the shallows. No people.
scenes.motion: The egrets take off together and fly across the frame low over the misty water, wings beating. No people or hands appear.
scenes.camera: The camera pans slowly to follow the birds.

scenes.title: Earth, sky and heaven: he steps into the river
scenes.description: First light. The sage stands waist-deep in the calm river, facing the glowing eastern horizon, seen from behind and slightly to the side, mist around him, a few stars still in the sky.
scenes.motion: The sage wades slowly forward through the water, the water swirling around his waist, mist drifting past. No other people appear.
scenes.camera: The camera tracks slowly alongside him.

scenes.title: That most excellent light of Savitṛ
scenes.description: The sun bursts over the far horizon of the river, long golden rays fanning across the sky, a blazing path of light on the water, clouds lit gold. No people.
scenes.motion: The sun rises visibly above the horizon, the rays sweep outward and the light races across the rippling water. No people or hands appear.
scenes.camera: The camera glides forward low over the water toward the sun.

scenes.title: We meditate on the radiance: the offering
scenes.description: Sunrise. The sage stands waist-deep in the river, seen in three-quarter view from behind, raising cupped hands full of water toward the rising sun as an offering, golden light all around him, mist on the water.
scenes.motion: He lifts his cupped hands and pours the water back into the river in a glittering stream that catches the sunlight. No other people appear.
scenes.camera: The camera slowly circles a little around him.

scenes.title: May it awaken our minds: falling water
scenes.description: Extreme close-up at sunrise: two weathered cupped hands of an old man, with a rudraksha bracelet, letting a stream of water pour into a river, every droplet glittering gold, the rising sun blurred behind. Only the hands and forearms are visible.
scenes.motion: The water pours and splashes into the river, droplets sparkling and scattering.

scenes.title: The lotus opens
scenes.description: Morning light on the river: a single pink lotus bud on the golden water among green lotus leaves, sunlight sparkling on the ripples. No people.
scenes.motion: The lotus bud opens fully into a flower, petals unfolding one after another, as a gentle breeze moves the leaves. No people or hands appear.
scenes.camera: The camera pushes in toward the flower.

scenes.title: Morning over the river
scenes.description: Very high, very wide aerial view looking down along a wide sacred river in full morning light: long stone ghat steps and temple spires along the left bank, a few wooden boats on the shining water, golden sunlight on the ripples, and far below a single tiny distant figure in ochre standing waist-deep in the river, smaller than the boats. Full-bleed scene, no border, no close-up figures.
scenes.motion: Birds fly across the shining river and the boats drift slowly on the current; the water sparkles. No other people appear.
scenes.camera: The camera rises up and pulls back into a high wide view.
